extraction_notes: Main-text performance data were digitised from Figure 3 only. Figure 4 panels were not extracted because they are Arrhenius and reaction-order plots; Figures 1 and 2 are thermodynamic/mechanistic/characterisation plots, not measured synthesis performance plots. Figure 3a low-temperature Mn–LiH, Fe–LiH and Co–LiH points were read from the inset where more legible. Figure 3b uses a logarithmic y-axis; points at the plotted detection-limit line were recorded as plotted values with explanatory notes.
